name: NadiFin Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: loquisoft

sections.description:
Welcome to the NadiFin Crypto Payment Gateway—the professional, non-custodial solution for WooCommerce merchants who need reliable, borderless payments. Our platform eliminates the risks of traditional banking by providing instant settlements and automated swap technology. Your customers pay in their preferred digital assets, and you receive stable USDC on the Polygon network instantly.

With our advanced infrastructure, merchants can accept payments globally in multiple major digital assets, featuring:
* BTC (Bitcoin): Accept the world’s premier digital currency natively with instant transaction monitoring.
* ETH (Ethereum): Process native Ether payments with rapid block validation and settlement.
* LTC (Litecoin): Enable low-fee, high-speed transactions seamlessly.
* XMR (Monero): Support secure and private transactions for privacy-focused users.
* SOL (Solana): Experience sub-second payment confirmation times with near-zero network fees.
* USDT (Tether): Accept the most widely used stablecoin across multiple primary blockchain networks.
* USDC (USD Coin): Take payments in the highly regulated, fully backed digital dollar ecosystem.
* BNB (Binance Coin): Support ecosystem payments directly via the high-throughput BNB Smart Chain.
* XRP (Ripple): Enable institutional-grade speed and efficiency for global cross-border payments.
* DOGE (Dogecoin): Tap into a massive, highly active global community with ultra-low payment friction.
* ADA (Cardano): Accept transactions secured by a peer-reviewed, research-driven blockchain network.
* TRX (Tron): Support massive high-volume transactions utilizing the highly efficient Tron network.

Whether you are a high-risk business rejected by banks, a global SaaS platform, or a traditional e-commerce merchant, NadiFin ensures your funds are never frozen and your revenue is completely protected from market volatility.

Powerful Features & Capabilities

We provide everything you need to accept crypto seamlessly. NadiFin includes the following comprehensive features out of the box:

  • Instant Auto-swap & USDC Payouts
  • No KYC & No Middle-man
  • Reusable Payment Links
  • One-time Payment Links
  • Subscription & Invoice links
  • Donation Support
  • QR Code Checkout Generator
  • Cart Abandonment Recovery
  • Volume cap: unlimited /month
  • Currency Converter Tool
  • Full Chargeback Protection
  • Export transactions by status / date filters
  • Branded & Whitelabel Checkout
  • WooCommerce & Shopify Support
  • Developer APIs & documentation
  • 24/7 Priority Merchant Support

Supported Industries

We specialize in providing secure, stable payment pathways for high-volume and high-risk industries, but we are absolutely not limited to these sectors. We proudly welcome merchants from all backgrounds and global jurisdictions. A small sample of industries we support includes:

  • Adult Entertainment
  • IPTV & High-Volume Hosting
  • CBD & Hemp
  • Peptides & Research Chemicals
  • SaaS Platforms & Proxies
  • Forex Education & Trading
  • Online Gaming & Sports Betting
  • Traditional E-commerce & Retail
  • Digital Downloads & Media Subscriptions
  • Consulting, Freelance & Agency Services
  • …and virtually any other legal business model.
sections.installation:
1. Create an Account: Apply at https://nadifin.com — approval is instant with no upfront documents required.
  2. Configure Plugin: In your WooCommerce settings, navigate to the Payments tab and enter your NadiFin API Key and Secret.
  3. Webhook Setup: Copy the webhook endpoint displayed in the plugin settings directly into your NadiFin Dashboard.
  4. Sync Coins: Click “Save changes” to automatically sync your enabled cryptocurrencies and start processing instantly.
sections.faq:
Is this legal?

Yes, accepting cryptocurrency as a medium of exchange is completely legal in the vast majority of global jurisdictions. Our infrastructure simply facilitates the technical transfer of digital assets.

Can my funds be frozen?

No. We utilize a strict non-custodial settlement model. As soon as the transaction is processed, your funds are pushed directly to your own secure wallet on the blockchain. We do not hold your money, so it cannot be frozen by us or any traditional bank.

Is KYC required for my customers or my business?

No. NadiFin operates with a strict No KYC policy for merchants, and your customers are never required to upload identity documents to pay in cryptocurrency.

What cryptocurrencies can my customers pay with?

NadiFin supports top global cryptocurrencies, allowing your customers to pay effortlessly in Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), Litecoin (LTC), Monero (XMR), USDT, USDC, BNB, Ripple (XRP), Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA), and Tron (TRX).

Why does NadiFin settle automatically in USDC?

We use a cost-saving architecture designed to protect merchants from massive network fees and crypto market volatility. While your customers have the freedom to pay in their preferred coin, NadiFin automatically sweeps the funds, manages network gas, and settles your earnings directly into your secure USDC wallet (Polygon network).

How does the checkout process work?

When a customer checks out, NadiFin instantly calculates the live exchange rate based on your fiat pricing (USD, EUR, GBP) and generates a unique mathematical child-wallet deposit address. Once the customer sends the crypto, our background nodes detect the payment, sweep the funds, and fire a webhook to automatically mark the order as paid in your store.

What fee does NadiFin charge?

NadiFin charges only a 1% fee per transaction. To convert the customer’s native cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Litecoin) into USDC on the Polygon network, the transaction passes through an automated cross-chain liquidity bridge. This may incur a small dynamic swap fee (typically ~0.5%) charged by the protocol, which is seamlessly factored into your final net payout.

Does NadiFin Payout Instantly?

Settlement is fully automated. As soon as a customer’s payment hits the required network confirmations, NadiFin bridges the funds directly to your designated USDC wallet. You maintain absolute self-custody, while most payouts arrive within an hour.

Please understand, a payout may take up to 24 hours in rare instances. This is an automated safeguard specifically built to protect your profits. If gas fees on the customer’s chosen blockchain experience an extreme, temporary spike, our system pauses the sweep until network congestion clears.

What if a customer underpays?

Our system monitors the blockchain in real-time. If a customer sends less than the required amount, the transaction status will reflect the partial payment and our dynamic checkout will prompt the customer to fulfill the remaining balance before the system registers it as a completed order.

How do refunds work?

Because cryptocurrency payments are final and irreversible on the blockchain, there are no forced chargebacks. Any refunds you wish to grant must be handled manually between you and your customer, keeping you in complete control of your business capital.

Which countries are supported?

NadiFin is truly global. Merchants from almost anywhere in the world can integrate our gateway to receive USDC, and your customers can pay you globally, subject only to standard international compliance.

Where can I find the API documentation?

You can find our comprehensive API documentation directly in your Merchant Dashboard or by visiting our dedicated developer API Docs page. It includes exact endpoint structures, webhook payload formats, code examples, and step-by-step integration guides for over 20 supported e-commerce platforms.

What kind of support does NadiFin offer?

We provide comprehensive API documentation, detailed integration guides, and dedicated 24/7 priority support to ensure your store is successfully set up and processing payments smoothly.
